yorum: We stayed at this beautiful apart hotel on 3 separate occasions last year and have booked again for this year. It’s in a stunning location right opposite the beach. The views from the hotel are unbeatable. The apartments themselves are basic but have everything you might need and are spotlessly clean. This is a family run hotel and the family and staff are wonderful and extremely friendly. This stretch of Torba is vey Quiet but there’s a regular Dolmus service into Bodrum which takes about 10 minutes. Absolutely fabulous hotel and location.

Beautiful place with the cozy white houses, beautiful flowers in the garden, lovely cats, clean and nice pool area, helpful personnel, good breakfast, nice sun bathing deck at the shore, nice views of the ocean. Clean, cleaning every day. Warm water in the shower all the time. We had a nice little private terrace with view of pool and ocean. Totally recommend, simple but wonderful! Most cozy place in Torba. Good location with easy access to bodrum by taxi or bus (20 minutes). If you don't want the big unpersonal hotel complexes, and rather something small, authentic and beautiful, this is for you! The bad things was the very very hard beds, wifi not working most of the time and no safety deposit box in the room.

Great hotel We are very happy to stay at Omar Hotel, as service is perfect. It’s right on the beach, where we spend most of the time, sea is warm and pleasant to swim in, one’s needs water shoes though as bottom is rocky. Breakfast has lots of options incl coffee tea and juice. Rooms are decent size, We we’re 3 people and had 2 bedrooms apt with large balcony. Everyday housekeeping. They have pool for adults and kids. Owners and employees really trying best to make you feel comfortable. I will definitely come back. Highly recommended.
